scope: Read-only source audit plus in-memory negative controls; no repository/native/browser/chain action

findings.issue: Rebound top-level input identity passes while the hash-bound scientific artifact/proof input fields remain different.
findings.fix: Cross-check artifact.inputHash and proof.inputSha256 against binding and EVM input, and check graphBindingSha256 against recomputed binding.

findings.issue: Empty lifecycle transaction lists pass every() and retain accepted=true.
findings.fix: Require declared nonempty exact lifecycle stages/count before accepting statuses.

findings.issue: execFile failure console is only written on success; failure.json omits child stdout/stderr.
findings.fix: Persist child stdout/stderr and available execution metadata in the failure path.

findings.issue: Existing node_modules directory alone suppresses npm ci and can make incomplete dependency state appear ready when artifacts also exist.
findings.fix: Check actual required dependency installation against lock before reporting ready; refuse or repair only declared owned dependencies.
